newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Insurance firms want to bid for Philippine T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Insurance firms want to bid for Philippine T-bills.

text.p: Two insurance companies have applied to bid for Philippine Treasury bills and bonds in the primary market, a Bureau of Treasury official said on Monday.

Treasury's director for government securities Juanchito Dispo said Ayala Life Assurance Inc, a unit of Ayala Corp and Sun Life Assurance Co of Canada, a unit of Sun Life Corp have applied to become accredited government securities dealers.
Licences are expected to be issued before the end of the year.

"It will result in a deeper market," Dispo said, adding that insurance companies could buy government securities, especially the long-term bonds, directly from the government without paying intermediation cost to banks.
At present, there are 43 accredited dealers mostly commercial banks. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
